about.description: 👋 Fullstack Software Engineer | JavaScript & TypeScript Enthusiast

description: Full‑stack Software Engineer focused on JavaScript/TypeScript delivering robust, maintainable web apps end‑to‑end — from UX to production.
I design scalable front‑ends with modern tooling and accessible UI, and build reliable back‑ends with Node.js, REST/GraphQL APIs, and secure data layers.
Tech I work with regularly: TypeScript, Node.js, Express/Nest, PostgreSQL/MongoDB, Prisma/Sequelize, Redis, Webpack/Vite, Jest, Playwright, Docker, GitHub Actions, and cloud deployments (Vercel/AWS).
My experience spans dashboards, e‑commerce, content sites, and internal tools — translating product goals into measurable outcomes users love.
I collaborate closely with designers and product folks, write clear documentation, and mentor teammates to keep velocity high without sacrificing quality.
I enjoy exploring new technologies and patterns, but stay pragmatic — choosing tools that fit the problem and scale with the product.
Open to freelance or remote opportunities — let’s build something users love.
